risk.short: Trading leveraged products carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for everyone. Instant-funded accounts are simulated: no real capital is traded and past performance is no guarantee of future results. Nothing on this page is investment advice.
risk.title: Risk disclosure
risk.p1: Trading leveraged products such as crypto derivatives carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for all investors. Prices can move rapidly, and leverage magnifies both gains and losses.
risk.p2: All funded accounts offered by {{brand}} are simulated. No real capital is traded on financial markets, and any profit or loss shown is hypothetical. Payouts are discretionary rewards based on simulated performance and are subject to our terms and conditions.
risk.p3: Simulated or hypothetical results have inherent limitations and do not reflect actual trading, including the impact of liquidity, slippage and execution. Past performance, whether real or simulated, is not a reliable indicator of future results.
risk.p4: {{brand}} is not a broker, bank or investment firm, does not provide investment advice and does not hold client funds. Trading with your own funds, where offered, is provided by a licensed third-party broker under its own terms and regulatory regime.
risk.p5: Market data is supplied by third parties and may be delayed, interrupted or inaccurate. Our services are not available in certain jurisdictions, including countries under EU sanctions or on the FATF high-risk lists, or where their use would be contrary to local law.
risk.p6: Nothing on this website constitutes financial, investment, tax or legal advice, or an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any financial instrument. Only participate with money you can afford to lose.

q1.a: You buy access to a simulated funded account and can start trading straight away — there is no evaluation phase. You trade within fixed risk rules and can request payouts when you meet the payout conditions.

q2.a: No. All funded accounts are simulated: no real capital is traded on the market. Payouts are rewards based on your simulated performance, as described in the terms.

q3.a: Each account has a daily loss limit and a maximum drawdown. Your dashboard shows in real time how close you are. If a limit is breached, the account is closed automatically.

q4.q: Can I lose more than the fee?
q4.a: No. The account is simulated, so your maximum cost is the fee you paid. You never owe more than that.

q5.a: Once you meet the payout conditions you can request a payout from your dashboard. Before your first payout we verify your identity (KYC). Every request is reviewed.

q6.a: Major crypto pairs such as BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT, 24/7. Prices are based on live market data from Binance USDⓈ-M futures.

q7.a: We cannot offer accounts in countries under EU sanctions or on the FATF high-risk lists. Your country is checked when you sign up and before payouts.

q8.q: Can I trade with my own money?
q8.a: We are preparing an option to trade with your own funds through a licensed partner broker. We never hold client money ourselves.

brand.body: Your name, colours and domain. Players never see ours.

admin.title: Separate admin panel
admin.body: One owner per operator, two-step verification, every action in an unchangeable audit log.

market.title: Real market prices
market.body: Crypto perpetuals with spread, slippage and commission — the same engine as our prop-firm platform.

languages.title: EN · NL · ES
languages.body: All player and admin screens in three languages.

revenue.title: What one round can bring in.
revenue.body: Every entry goes into the pot. By default 80% is paid to the top 3 (50/30/20) and 20% stays with you.
revenue.month: About {{amount}} per month at one round a day.
revenue.disclaimer: Example calculation, not a forecast or guarantee. Actual numbers depend on your players, costs, taxes and licence.

legal.title: Paid competitions need a licence
legal.body: A paid entry with a prize pool is usually regulated as gambling in the EU. You run the competition under your own licence; we supply the software. Until a licensed payment provider is connected, only test payments are possible.

cta.title: Launch your own competition.
cta.body: We show you the player and admin side in a 30-minute demo.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.firmSuspended: This firm is suspended: traders cannot log in, register or buy.
admin.reasonHint: Required. Stored in the audit log (no personal data).

forbidden.title: No access to the admin panel
forbidden.body: The admin panel is only for the admin of a prop firm and Daily Funded. Client accounts have no access.

2fa.title: Turn on two-step verification first
2fa.body: The admin panel gives access to trader data and account actions, so it requires two-step verification on your login.

overview.subtitle: How your platform is doing. Amounts in EUR, last 30 days unless stated.
overview.chartCaption: Paid sales per day over the last 30 days.
overview.noSales: No paid sales in the last 30 days yet

traders.subtitle: Everyone registered on your platform.
traders.suspendBody: They are signed out everywhere and cannot log in until reactivated. Their accounts stay as they are.
traders.reactivateBody: They can log in and trade again.

accounts.subtitle: All trading accounts on your platform (simulated).
accounts.failBody: Open positions are closed at market, open orders are cancelled and the account is marked as failed. This cannot be undone.
accounts.emptyBody: Accounts appear here once traders register or buy.

products.subtitle: What traders can buy on your platform.
products.newBody: An instant funded account at a fixed size and price.
products.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, e.g. instant-15k
products.slugInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and dashes
products.editBody: Changes apply to new purchases only.
products.snapshotNote: Every purchase keeps the price and rule set it was bought with, so changes never affect existing accounts.

ruleSets.subtitle: Trading rules for your products. Templates come from Daily Funded; you can base your own versions on them.
ruleSets.name: Name
ruleSets.newVersionBody: Based on {{name}} v{{version}}. Existing accounts keep their rules.
ruleSets.immutableNote: Rule sets can never be edited: a change is always a new version, and every account stays on the version it was opened with.

branding.subtitle: How your platform looks to traders: name, colour, logo and domain.
branding.name: Platform name
branding.nameHint: Shown to traders, e.g. in the header when there is no logo.
branding.colorHint: Used for buttons and highlights. Text colours are adjusted automatically for readability.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, max. 200 KB. A wide logo on a transparent background works best.
branding.logoType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image
branding.logoSize: The image is larger than 200 KB
branding.domainHint: Point this domain to the platform (DNS) and traders land on your brand.
branding.previewBody: Buttons, tabs and highlights in your colour.

alerts.subtitle: Signals that may need attention. Acknowledge them once handled.
alerts.emptyBody: Breaches, near-breaches and large losses appear here.

detail.BREACH: {{rule}} was breached; positions were closed automatically.

audit.subtitle: Every order, rule event and admin action on your platform. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.
audit.intact: The audit chain is intact ({{count}} entries checked).
audit.broken: The audit chain is broken at entry {{id}}. Contact Daily Funded.
audit.emptyBody: Entries appear as soon as something happens on your platform.
audit.note: Each entry contains the hash of the previous one, so any change would be detectable. No personal data is stored here, only ids.

firms.subtitle: All prop firms running on Daily Funded.
firms.newHint: The firm starts with the example catalogue; its admin receives an email to set a password (2FA is required).
firms.name: Name
firms.changeAdminBody: The current admin is deactivated and signed out. The new admin receives an email to set a password.

login.title: Partner login
login.subtitle: Admin panel for prop firms on Daily Funded.
login.note: Admin accounts are created by Daily Funded. No account yet? Contact your Daily Funded contact person.
login.demoHint: Preview: sign in as Daily Funded with

modules.subtitle: Choose what your clients see in their dashboard. Switched-off modules disappear from the menu and cannot be opened.
modules.coreNote: Home, Trade, Withdrawal, Order history, My stats and Settings are always on.

desc.points: Clients earn points for activity and redeem them for discounts.
desc.offers: Personal discount codes for new accounts.
desc.leaderboard: Public ranking of funded traders (opt-in, nickname only).
desc.competitions: Free monthly trading competition with a separate account.
desc.copier: Copy trades from one own account to another.
desc.backtesting: Test a strategy on historical prices in the browser.

setup.title: Set-up

detail.DEDICATED_READY: own database created, migrated and filled

setup.dnsIntro: Add these records at the domain's DNS provider. The domain becomes active as soon as both are found — we check automatically every minute.
setup.name: Name
setup.dnsNote: DNS changes can take up to a few hours. A certificate (HTTPS) is issued automatically once the domain is active.
setup.ownDomainHint: E.g. trade.yourfirm.com — verified via DNS before it is used.
setup.dedicatedHint: The firm gets its own database and runs on its own instance; data is never on the shared platform.
setup.dedicatedUnavailable: Not available: own databases are not configured on this platform.
setup.newHint: The firm is set up automatically and is immediately reachable at {{domain}}. The admin receives an invitation by e-mail.
setup.dialogBody: Every step runs automatically and is retried until it succeeds.
setup.ownInstanceBody: This firm runs on its own instance with its own database. Its traders and admin panel are served there, not on the shared platform. The instance configuration is printed with: pnpm --filter @brand/api firm:instance-env {{slug}}
setup.brandingIntro: Your platform is always reachable on its subdomain. An own domain is used once DNS is verified.
